name: wendy-agentic-coding
description: Wendy CLI setup, device installation and first-boot checks, template apps, explicit deployment targets, ROS 2 and robot verification workflows.

hooks.command: [ -f "${CLAUDE_PROJECT_DIR:-.}/wendy.json" ] || exit 0; if command -v wendy >/dev/null 2>&1; then printf 'Wendy project. Wendy CLI: %s\n' "$(WENDY_ANALYTICS=false wendy --version 2>/dev/null)"; else printf 'Wendy project, but the Wendy CLI is not installed. Offer /wendy-install to set it up.\n'; fi
